تستأجرن (form X)

# تُسْتَأْجَرْنَ (tustaʔjarna) /tus.taʔ.d͡ʒar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
